source: Interview files: the artist's own Wix site, read out of a saved copy of its /events page. Exhibition videos: his YouTube channel, via karim-media/data.
note: The old site played each interview from a Wix-hosted MP4 whose asset id is the stem of its poster filename, which is how each file is joined to its entry — the mapping is exact, not inferred. These URLs are the old site's CDN: if that site goes away they stop working, so the durable fix is to commit the files under public/media/video and point 'file' at those instead. Exhibition posters are the YouTube stills, copied from karim-media/video into public/media/video.
